notes.title: 1.04.00 Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312837/22ef9c3df815d57ca7f06dbc014c30a3746e69ce.png[/img]

# New Feature
- Added in-game dialogues
    * About credit status
    * About progress status
- Added 3 new BGM tracks
    * Adjusted conditions for certain BGM to play

# Other Update
- Extended the time before automatic deletion of customer information
- Increased difficulty for triggering the charity campaign
- Automatic check for tutorial skip
- Replaced some character illustrations

# Tweaks
- Reduced load impact when starting the game
- Restricted pausing during the ending sequence
- Restricted pausing during loading screens
- Fixed an issue where some translations were missing when exiting the game
- Internal adjustments related to Steamworks

notes.title: Good Sleep Companyリリース日のお知らせ
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312837/f1c4adbdc856a1aeee9b3840f51d0a2955d5cbf5.png[/img]

Good Sleep Company now on released!!
Launch special sale for Dec 23th 20% OFF!

[h3]About multi language support[/h3]
I'm afraid to say, in first launch, it don't support other languages. But I'm working on English(MT based) support version. The version will appear probably in this year.

[h3]Update Schedules[/h3]

[h4]SOON[/h4]
- English Support
- Improved upper scroll
- Out of window event notifications
[h4]NEXT[/h4]
- Add character assets
- Add more BGM
- STEAM achievements
- statistics
- credit change popup
[h4]POSSIBLY[/h4]
- customers decrease result
[h4]What is...?[/h4]
- More costume.

Thanks, and have a fan!
